id.description: Identifier of the sent message: the Out-of-Band 1.1 invitation on a v1 connection, the share-media message that carries the Out-of-Band 2.0 invitation on a v2 connection.

outOfBandId.description: Identifier of the Out-of-Band record created for a sub-connection invitation. Absent for a referral. The connection the invitation produces carries this value as `outOfBandId`.

404.description: No connection with the given id
